entities.name: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
observations: First-degree relatives, including children, require serial clinical screening with ECG and echocardiography; early-onset familial disease supports screening during childhood and repeat surveillance.

entities.name: Pediatric HCM family screening
observations: For an asymptomatic child with an affected first-degree relative, serial ECG plus echocardiography is recommended; a one-time or symptom-triggered study is inadequate. Among the listed options, annual echocardiography is the closest, though ECG should also be included.
